_comment: The Lynbro suite. Canonical source: plugins/_shared/lynbro-core/lynbro-suite.json, copied verbatim into every plugin by tools/sync_lynbro_core.py. Data, not code: the shell reads it for the 'Our plugins' cards and for the order of the shared menu, and corrects 'wporg' against the live wordpress.org listing at runtime. Refresh the flags with: python tools/sync_lynbro_core.py --refresh 'shell': false marks a suite plugin that does not load the shared shell yet (no copy is written into it; it still appears among the cards). 'fits' lists when the plugin is suggested to a site that does not have it yet: each rule is a signal name, or several joined with '+' that must all hold. Signals (computed locally by Lynbro_Core_Feedback::site_signals): woocommerce, forms, danish, comments, tracking, accounts.
